# Part B — Lightweight optimisation (v2)

Protocol: v2.1: grouped 5-fold CV on train+val (340 videos) for every choice; test evaluated once.
Selection rule: cheapest config with OOF mAP >= best - max(0.01, SE_best); cost: no-CNN < CNN, logreg < lgbm < xgb < catboost, shorter W.
